Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You find the words people begin repeating to one another before you have finished speaking.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Time
Ten minutes per attempt.
Target / range / shape
An audience able to hear; 10 minutes
Duration
Information and earned progress persist for the stated task; completed changes remain until circumstances alter them.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill

Address an audience able to hear and understand you. Propose one plausible collective objective, such as providing volunteers, granting access or organizing evacuation. The DA states a binary or cumulative progress target and which listeners are willing to consider it. Completion secures the stated cooperation from willing participants, not authority over everyone present; their own choices and new events still matter.

Weak
1 progress; identify an objection voiced by the audience.
Standard
2 progress; also identify a willing spokesperson who can explain that objection.
Strong
3 progress; also identify willing volunteers who can organize the agreed practical next step, if such people are present.
